DSH 默认模型未就绪，当前用规则判断代替 AI 分拣：只能识别明显的通知和营销: The DSH default model is not ready, so rules stand in for AI triage: only obvious notices and marketing are recognized, and workflows set to “Handle after AI confirms” receive nothing automatically. You choose instead.
分类决定要不要处理，匹配决定交给哪个方案: Categories decide whether to handle; matching decides which workflow

不处理，在“待我决策”里建议方案，由你确认或点“不是这个”: Not handled; the workflow is suggested in Needs me for you to confirm or decline
列为未匹配，可手动选择方案或忽略: Left unmatched; choose a workflow or ignore it
只有设为“字面命中就处理”的方案会自动接收: Only workflows set to “Handle every literal match” receive messages automatically
记为方案的例子，之后判断相似信息时参考: Saved as examples for the workflow and used for similar messages
AI 判断符合适用说明才处理；拿不准时交给你确认；没有 AI 时不自动处理。: Handled only when AI finds the message fits the description; uncertain cases come to you; nothing is handled automatically without AI.
符合来源、文件夹和字面条件的信息都交给这个方案，不经 AI 判断。适合专用文件夹: Every message meeting the source, folder and literal conditions goes to this workflow without AI. Suits dedicated folders such as “Resumes”.
写清楚适用和不适用的情况，AI 按这段判断。没写时只能参考方案名称和处理要求，容: Describe what fits and what does not; AI judges by this. Without it AI only has the name and instructions to go on and misjudges more easily.
例如：客户正式下单、改单或催单；不包括询价、售后、发票和内部通知: e.g. a customer places, changes or chases an order; not inquiries, after-sales, invoices or internal notices
建议填写适用说明，尤其是名称宽泛的方案（如“订单处理”）。: Add a description, especially for broadly named workflows such as “Orders”.
来自你的确认和纠正，最近 8 条提供给 AI: From your confirmations and corrections; the latest 8 are given to AI
还没有例子。在事项上确认 AI 的建议、手动选择这个方案，或点“不是这个方案”时: No examples yet. They are recorded when you confirm an AI suggestion, choose this workflow by hand, or click “Not this workflow” on an item.
新信息先由 AI 判断类别和适用方案，通知与营销邮件自动归档，可随时恢复。关闭后: AI first judges each new message's category and workflow; notices and marketing are archived and can be restored. When off, all workflows match by literal conditions.
